name: karpathy-guidelines
tagline_zh: 写代码总被自己绕晕？Karpathy 亲测的纪律：只改该改的，说清假设，验收可验证。让 AI 不再过度设计。
tagline_en: Tired of AI overengineering? Karpathy's rules: surgical edits, explicit assumptions, verifiable done. Cleaner.
desc_en: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
why_zh: 同类指南爱讲大道理，它却把「不过度设计」变成可执行的检查清单，连验收标准都替你定义好了。
why_en: Unlike vague advice, it turns 'avoid overcomplication' into a concrete checklist, even pre-defining verifiable success criteria.
